info.title: Recoup API - AI
info.description: API documentation for the Recoup platform - an AI agent platform for the music industry

get.description: Returns the catalog of language models available through the Vercel AI Gateway. Embedding models are filtered out. The full schema mirrors the Vercel AI Gateway response (`GatewayLanguageModelEntry` from `@ai-sdk/gateway`); the documented properties below are the load-bearing fields used by clients. No authentication required.

500.description: Internal server error - failed to fetch models from the gateway

models.description: List of language models available through the Vercel AI Gateway

GatewayLanguageModelEntry.description: A language model entry as returned by the Vercel AI Gateway. Full schema mirrors the upstream `GatewayLanguageModelEntry` type from `@ai-sdk/gateway`.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the model

modelType.description: Type of model - embedding models are filtered out before the response is returned

pricing.description: Per-token pricing information as reported by the gateway

specification.description: Model specification metadata (provider, version, capabilities). Shape mirrors the gateway response.

context_window.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can process in a single request (input + output combined). Clients use this to gate model selection against per-request token budgets.

cost.description: Per-million-token pricing in USD. Derived from `pricing` (which is per-token) for client-side display.

input.description: USD cost per million input tokens.

output.description: USD cost per million output tokens.

message.description: Error message describing what went wrong
